whatIs.eyebrow: What is The Digital Door Knock?
whatIs.body: Your all-in-one marketing system for real estate. Professionally filmed content, fully managed social media, and paid ads that turn attention into appraisals.

items.title: Content Creation
items.description: Professionally filmed reels and high quality photos. Visuals built to get attention in your suburb.

items.title: Social Media Management
items.description: Scripting, editing, captions, carousels, scheduling, posting. You stay front of mind without touching the apps.

items.title: Paid Ads
items.description: Profile growth and lead generation campaigns for buyers and sellers. Strategic ad spend that turns content into enquiries.

items.title: Reporting
items.description: Clear monthly reports across every platform. What's working, what isn't, what we're doing next.

process.title: The Process
process.subtitle: How we get you from day one to live in 14 days.

steps.title: Strategise
steps.description: We audit your suburb, your competitors, and your current online presence. Build a plan specific to you.

steps.title: Create
steps.description: Our team films, edits, scripts, and prepares everything. You approve, we publish.

steps.title: Grow
steps.description: Ads turn on. Content stacks. Leads come in. Bi-weekly reporting keeps everything sharp.

caseStudy.objective: Use social media to list and sell more property.
caseStudy.resultDetail: One piece of content. Three new listings on the back of it. That's what happens when content earns attention and the system turns it into leads.

checkAvailability.auditIntro:
Before you commit to anything, we show you exactly what's happening in your market, for free.

In a 15-minute call with Blake, you'll walk away with:

auditItems.title: Your Competitor Snapshot
auditItems.description: We audit the top 5 agents in your suburb and show you exactly what content they're posting (or not posting).

auditItems.title: Your Visibility Score
auditItems.description: We assess your current online presence across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and LinkedIn and score it against the local benchmark.

auditItems.title: Your Opportunity Map
auditItems.description: Based on your suburb's demographics, property volume, and competitor activity, we'll show you the content angles that give you the fastest path to local dominance.

checkAvailability.auditFootnote: No pitch. No pressure. If your area isn't a fit for the exclusivity model, we'll tell you straight up.
